title: John 8:31-33 — “The truth will make you free”; “We are Abraham’s descendants”
summary: John 8:31-33: Jesus tells believing Jews that if they continue in His word they will know the truth and the truth will make them free; they answer that they are Abraham’s descendants and have never been enslaved. Jesus' words and 'the truth' are in red, Abraham in blue.

text.text: 31 So Jesus was saying to those Jews who had believed Him, “If you continue in My word, then you are truly disciples of Mine;
32 and you will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
33 They answered Him, “We are Abraham’s descendants and have never yet been enslaved to anyone; how is it that You say, ‘You will become free’?”

keywords: the truth shall make you free
